nodes.name: Daily 06:00 Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 06:00. Fetches and re-scores all open critical/high vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: Fetch EPSS Scores
nodes.notes: EPSS API (first.org) — free, no auth required. Returns probability of exploitation in next 30 days.

nodes.name: Fetch NVD CVSS v3 Data
nodes.notes: NVD API v2 — free with API key (500 req/30s). Provides CVSS v3 vector, severity, CWE.

meta.description: Runs every weekday morning. Fetches all open high/critical CVEs, enriches with EPSS exploitation probability scores from FIRST.org, computes composite risk score (CVSS 40% + EPSS 45% + asset criticality 15%), re-ranks priority queue, and alerts on SLA breaches.
